youtube.title: Day 1: This Kitchen Is 1,300x Longer Than Her #Shorts
youtube.description:
Day one. For a 3 mm ant, a 4 m kitchen floor is about 1,300 times her own length. Pip crosses it for one grain of sugar - and leaves behind the road her whole colony follows.

What tiny thing in your house would make the best adventure? Tell me below.

Real facts in this story:
- Odorous house ant workers are about 2.4-3.3 mm long and favour sugary food in kitchens (Penn State Extension).
- Ants can lift and carry many times their own body weight (Ask A Biologist, Arizona State University).
- A scout that finds food lays a chemical (pheromone) trail on the way home; nestmates follow it and reinforce it (research on trail recruitment, e.g. University of Regensburg).
- 1,300x: our own estimate, a 4 m kitchen divided by a 3 mm ant.

Sources:
https://extension.psu.edu/odorous-house-ant
https://askabiologist.asu.edu/content/ant-factoids
https://epub.uni-regensburg.de/59034/1/s00040-024-00995-y.pdf

AI disclosure: this animation was made with AI assistance (script drafting, synthetic narration voice, procedurally rendered 3D animation). The story is illustrative; the facts above are real.
